description: This file contains test utility functions, classes, and mocks related to socket connection testing in the Chromium project. It defines methods for verifying socket load timing info, setting IP addresses, and a mock socket factory with configurable behaviors for unit tests.

classes.name: MockTransportClientSocketFactory
classes.description: A mock socket factory class used for testing, capable of producing sockets with various behaviors such as synchronous, asynchronous, failing, delayed, stalled, or triggerable connections.

methods.name: TestLoadTimingInfoConnectedReused
methods.description: Verifies that the socket handle correctly sets load timing info when a socket is reused.

methods.name: TestLoadTimingInfoConnectedNotReused
methods.description: Verifies that the socket handle correctly sets load timing info when a socket is newly connected.

methods.name: SetIPv4Address
methods.description: Sets the provided IPEndPoint to the IPv4 address 1.1.1.1:80.

methods.name: SetIPv6Address
methods.description: Sets the provided IPEndPoint to the IPv6 address [1:abcd::3:4:ff]:80.
